title: Pricing estimate request
description: Booking payload accepted by POST /.netlify/functions/pricing-estimate (Appendix A).

job_id.description: Stable identifier for this estimate request; echoed in the response.

service_category.description: Free-text category. Any string accepted; not strictly validated.

job_description.description: Homeowner free-text describing the job; the scope-extraction surface.

service_subtype.description: Sub-classification hint within the category; not a strict validator.

deadline.description: Exact canonical strings, including the ASCII apostrophe in I'm flexible.

booking_month.description: YYYY-MM resolution, matching the training dataset.

job_status.description: Free-text status from the homeowner's perspective. Accepted if provided.
